Models for CdTe PV production costs at different locations are shown in Figure 40, and details are reported in Appendix A. Small cost differentials between the non-U.S. manufacturing locations are primarily due to differences between local utility and labor costs. General duties are applied to the ASEAN and India models to reflect costs to import into the United States, while the United States model includes some Section 301 tariffs on materials or components that are generally not sourced from domestic suppliers. Overhead, financing, and profit are estimated from First Solar’s 2024 annual report (First Solar 2025a). The overall 44% gross margin reported by First Solar in 2024 included sales of modules and government grants including 45X. Fleet average 20% gross margins were reported when 45X revenues were excluded. Because First Solar sold $857 million of 45X tax credits generated during 2024 for $816 million, we calculate net 45X MPTC revenue to be approximately 95% of the full value.
